system.description:
In this lament, the Elves call to the setting sun to purge them of their grief—to take it into the sea where the sun sleeps, so that on the new day they might be free and clean of their sadness. This lament obeys all the standard rules for laments. See the Grief section for more.

Obstacle: See Grief Section

Actions: One day, from sunup to sundown

Elven spell song: counts as a sorcerous skill for practice and learning; tests are always open-ended (natural magic); no tools, no FoRKs; causes wonderment. Root is Will unless otherwise noted.

Restrictions: Elves only

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 147
